title: Nimble Japanese Chicken Gyoza
description: A quick and easy Japanese dish featuring chicken and thai bird chili, wrapped in a lotus leaf for a unique and delicious snack.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground chicken, chopped thai bird chili, soy sauce, sesame oil, chopped green onion, grated ginger, and minced garlic.
Mix everything together until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Lay a lotus leaf flat on a work surface, with the stem end facing you.
Place about 1 tablespoon of the chicken mixture in the center of the lotus leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining lotus leaves and chicken mixture.
Heat about 1 inch of water in a large skillet with a steamer basket over medium-high heat.
Place the gyoza in the steamer basket, leaving some space between each one.
Cover the skillet and steam the gyoza for 10 minutes, or until cooked through.
